subject: general
question: Which state won the Santosh Trophy in May 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 2022 Santosh Trophy was won by Kerala, who triumphed over West Bengal in a **5-4 penalty** shootout victory.
 
• The thrilling final took place at the **Manjeri Payyanad Stadium** in Malappuram, **Kerala**.
